pages.text: $(o)"Fluix Crystals possess the unique ability to absorb and convert energy from one form to another, and are the foundation of all Matter Energy technology"$()$(br2)One of the primary ingredients for AE2 blocks, $(l:ae2_mechanics/devices)devices$(/l), and items. Made by throwing nether quartz, redstone, and $(l:items_blocks_machines/certus_quartz_crystal_charged)Charged Certus Quartz Crystal$(/l) in water.

It can be $(l:example_setups/throw_in_water_automation)automated$(/l) using a $(l:items_blocks_machines/formation_plane)ME Formation Plane$(/l) and $(l:items_blocks_machines/annihilation_plane)ME Annihilation Plane$(/l).

pages.text: Throw the items into water together.
